_meta.note: One entry per reason_code in docs/formats/verdict.schema.json. app = 'Your app says' column, record = 'Your record says' column. {depositories} and {failed_depositories} are lists joined by the UI per language; *_inr params are rupees formatted by the UI in Indian style.

HOLDINGS_TOTAL_NONE_FOUND.app: Your app shows {claimed_value_inr} of shares in {claimed_count} holdings.
HOLDINGS_TOTAL_NONE_FOUND.record: None of them is in your name in the {depositories} record.

HOLDINGS_TOTAL_SOME_FOUND.app: Your app shows {claimed_value_inr} of shares in {claimed_count} holdings.
HOLDINGS_TOTAL_SOME_FOUND.record: Only {found_count} of {claimed_count} are in your name in the {depositories} record.

HOLDINGS_TOTAL_ALL_FOUND.app: Your app shows {claimed_value_inr} of shares in {claimed_count} holdings.
HOLDINGS_TOTAL_ALL_FOUND.record: All {claimed_count} are in your name in the {depositories} record.

HOLDINGS_TOTAL_INCOMPLETE.app: Your app shows {claimed_value_inr} of shares in {claimed_count} holdings.
HOLDINGS_TOTAL_INCOMPLETE.record: We could not check every depository ({failed_depositories} did not respond), so we cannot say whether these shares are yours.

HOLDING_QUANTITY_DIFFERS.record: {record_quantity} shares in your name at {depositories}, not {quantity}.

HOLDING_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.record: Not found at {depositories}, but {failed_depositories} could not be checked. We could not verify this.

HOLDING_NO_DEMAT.record: No demat account in your name at {depositories}. We could not verify this.

HOLDING_ISIN_UNMAPPED.record: We could not match this name to a listed share. We could not verify this.

BROKER_ON_SEBI_LIST.record: {name} is on the SEBI list of registered intermediaries ({sebi_reg_no}).

BROKER_NOT_ON_SEBI_LIST.app: Broker: {name}, says it is SEBI registered
BROKER_NOT_ON_SEBI_LIST.record: {name} is not on the SEBI list of registered intermediaries.

BROKER_NEAR_MATCH_AMBIGUOUS.record: The SEBI list has a similar name, {near_name}, but not {name}. We could not verify this.

BROKER_NOT_FOUND_NOT_CLAIMED.record: {name} is not on the SEBI list. We could not verify this.

BROKER_REG_NO_MISMATCH.record: On the SEBI list, {claimed_reg_no} is not the registration number of {name}.

PAYEE_VALID_HANDLE.record: {payee} is a SEBI @valid handle and is not in the Suspect Registry.

PAYEE_IN_SUSPECT_REGISTRY.record: {payee} is in the Suspect Registry of accounts reported for fraud.

PAYEE_BROKER_NOT_VALID_HANDLE.app: Pay to {payee}, described as a broker
PAYEE_BROKER_NOT_VALID_HANDLE.record: Registered brokers collect money through @valid handles. {payee} is not one.

PAYEE_NO_REGISTRY_HIT.record: {payee} is not in the Suspect Registry. We could not verify who owns it.

ENDORSEMENT_SOURCE_SAME.record: The original video has the same words.

ENDORSEMENT_WORDS_CHANGED.record: The original video exists, but the words were changed at {time_ranges}. Original words: "{original_quote}".

ENDORSEMENT_NO_SOURCE.record: We found no original video. We could not verify this. This does not mean the video is real.

PLATFORM_ON_RBI_ALERT_LIST.record: {name} is on the RBI Alert List of unauthorised forex platforms.

PLATFORM_NOT_ON_ALERT_LIST.record: {name} is not on the RBI Alert List. We could not verify this.
